links.outcome: Attending documentation time and productivity (wRVUs per shift hour) with ambient AI scribe versus no scribe
links.effect: Ambient AI scribes associated with 1.6-minute reduction in adjusted median attending documentation time per note (95% CI 0.3 to 2.9); human scribes 3.3 minutes (2.3 to 4.3); wRVUs per shift hour did not differ.
links.quote: Compared with encounters with no scribe, ambient AI scribes were associated with a 1.6-minute reduction in adjusted median attending documentation time per note (95% confidence interval 0.3 to 2.9), whereas human scribes were associated with a 3.3-minute reduction (95% confidence interval 2.3 to 4.3).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world operational impact of ambient AI scribes versus human scribes and no scribes on emergency physician documentation time and productivity.
